## From Local Shop to Online Store: A Simple Guide for Small Businesses

- March 4, 2025

- 2 Mins Read

- Share

- Intro-

- In today’s digital world, your customers are not just walking by your shop—they’re scrolling past your products on their phones. If you’re a small business owner looking to sell online but don’t know where to start, this guide is for you. No jargon, no coding—just practical steps to help you expand your business beyond the counter.

- 1. Start With Google Business Profile

- This is your free digital storefront. Add your business name, location, timings, and photos. This makes you discoverable on Google Maps and Search.

- 2. Use WhatsApp or Instagram for Orders

- Customers are already on these platforms. Create a WhatsApp Business account or an Instagram Shop. Post product pictures, respond to inquiries, and take orders easily.

- 3. Accept Payments Digitally Without a Website

- You don’t need a fancy e-commerce site to collect payments. Use services that let you share payment links via WhatsApp or SMS. Your customer clicks, pays securely, and you're done.

- 4. Manage Inventory With Your Smartphone

- Free inventory apps or a basic spreadsheet help you avoid running out of stock or over-ordering. Some POS systems even come with built-in barcode scanners to make things easier.

- 5. Offer Delivery or Pick-Up

- Tie up with a local delivery partner or offer customer pick-up. Add a small delivery fee if needed. Let customers choose convenience.

- 6. Keep Your Invoices Digital

- Use digital invoicing apps or tools that generate receipts instantly. It saves time and keeps things professional.

- 7. Stay in Touch With Customers

- A simple SMS after purchase or a monthly WhatsApp broadcast about new stock or offers keeps customers engaged and coming back.

- Wrap-Up

- You don’t need to become a tech expert to sell online. Start with what you have, go one step at a time, and remember—going digital doesn’t mean going complicated.

## Why a presentable shop can help you win more customers

- October 8, 2025

- 2 Mins Read

- Share

- Intro-

- In today’s competitive world, running a shop is about more than just selling great products—it’s about making a great first impression. Whether you run a kirana store, salon, café, or electronics shop, your physical space speaks volumes before you say a word.

- A neat, organized, and welcoming store can directly influence how much time customers spend inside—and how much money they’re willing to spend.

- Here’s why keeping your shop clean and presentable is a simple but powerful business strategy.

### 1. First Impressions Drive Decisions

- When a new customer walks in, they instantly form an opinion based on your layout, lighting, cleanliness, and product arrangement. A tidy store tells them you take pride in your business and can be trusted with their money.

- Pro Tip:

- Keep your entryway clean and uncluttered. A welcome mat, clear signage, and well-lit entrance create a warm vibe.

### 2. Display Matters—Make It Work for You

- Your products should be arranged in a way that guides the customer and makes their choices easier. Use shelves, stands, and simple labels to highlight bestsellers or new arrivals.

- Place high-margin or popular items at eye level and near the counter for better visibility and quicker decision-making.

### 3. A Clean Space = More Time Spent

- Customers are more likely to browse longer and discover new products in a clean, comfortable environment. A dusty shelf or chaotic counter can drive them away—even if your prices are great.

- Do a daily 10-minute sweep to clean surfaces, wipe mirrors/glass, and reset displays.

### 4. Better Organization Saves You Time Too

- When your products, tools, or billing materials are easy to find, you’ll work faster and reduce mistakes. That means quicker service, less frustration, and happier customers.

- Label storage drawers or shelves, and keep daily-use items within reach behind the counter.

### 5. Your Shop Reflects Your Brand

- Whether you realize it or not, customers associate your physical space with your business values. A neat store says “professional, trustworthy, quality.” A messy one says the opposite.

- Even small touches like uniform pricing tags, a clean POS device, or an organized cash counter show that you care.

## The Importance of Security in Point of Sale Machines: Protecting Your Business and Customers

- July 8, 2024

- 2 Mins Read

- Share

# Securing POS Devices: How Businesses Can Stay Safe in the Digital Age

- In today’s ever-evolving digital landscape,

- modern Point of Sale (POS) machines

- have become an essential part of both large and small-scale businesses. From retail stores to restaurants, POS devices help process transactions efficiently and securely. However, with any technology that handles sensitive information,

- POS machines come with their own set of security challenges

- It is vital for businesses to protect their POS terminals to not only safeguard business operations but also ensure the

- security of their customers' information

## Understanding Point of Sale (POS) Machines

- A

- Point of Sale (POS) machine

- , also known as a POS terminal, is a combination of hardware and software that allows businesses to complete sales transactions. Typically, a POS system includes:

- A computer or tablet

- A cash register

- A barcode scanner

- A receipt printer

- A card swiping machine

- In modern setups,

- POS systems are often integrated with UPI payment sound boxes

- , enabling seamless digital transactions for all types of businesses.

## Key Security Measures for POS Devices

- To keep your POS system secure, businesses must follow a layered approach involving data encryption, secure networking, and device management. Below are essential security practices:

### 1. Encryption of Data

- All data transmitted through POS machines should be

- encrypted

- to protect against data breaches.

- End-to-End Encryption (E2EE)

- ensures that payment information remains secure from the moment it is entered into the POS terminal until it reaches its destination.

- This prevents cybercriminals from intercepting and stealing sensitive customer data.

### 2. Regular Software Updates

- Businesses must ensure that their POS systems are always running the

- latest software version

- with up-to-date

- security patches

- Manufacturers and payment technology providers release updates to address vulnerabilities.

- Delaying or ignoring updates

- can leave systems exposed to potential threats.

### 3. Use of Secure Networks

- Always connect your POS machines to

- private, secure networks

- . Avoid public Wi-Fi, as it increases the risk of unauthorized access.

- Use

- firewalls

- and

- Virtual Private Networks (VPNs)

- to create an additional layer of protection and reduce exposure to cyber threats.

### 4. Strong Password Policies

- Implement and enforce

- strong password policies

- Use complex, unique passwords

- Change passwords regularly

- Avoid sharing credentials among employees

- two-factor or multi-factor authentication (2FA/MFA)

- for enhanced protection

## UPI Payment Sound Box: A New Layer of Security

- With the rising popularity of

- UPI (Unified Payments Interface)

- in India,

- UPI payment sound boxes

- have become a preferred solution for quick and convenient payments.

- These sound boxes confirm transactions audibly after customers scan a QR code, making them ideal for

- busy retail environments

- However, they also require security measures:

- Ensure

- secure integration

- with the POS system

- Comply with all necessary

- security standards and licenses

- Regularly monitor transactions

- for discrepancies

- Report any suspicious activity to your payment service provider immediately

## How to Secure Card Swiping Machines

- Card swiping devices are a vital part of the POS ecosystem and are often targeted by

- skimming attacks

- , where criminals install devices to steal card data.

- Follow these best practices to protect your swiping machines:

- tamper-evident security seals

- Conduct

- regular inspections

- to detect unauthorized attachments or tampering

- Opt for

- EMV-compliant card readers

- (chip-enabled) which are safer than magnetic stripe readers

## Conclusion

- In an era of increasing

- cyber threats and data breaches

- , securing your POS system is

- non-negotiable

- . Businesses must implement:

- End-to-end encryption

- Regular software updates

- Private and secure networks

- Strong access controls and password policies

- Advanced solutions like

- UPI sound boxes

markdown:
## Grievance Redressal and Dispute Resolution Framework

- Mswipe Technologies Private Limited

- 1. Introduction:

- Mswipe Technologies Private Limited (“herein referred to as Mswipe”) Vision is to create a state of art payment and financial ecosystem with innovative products and superior customer service.

- Merchant and Customer experience is a key focus area of Mswipe. Mswipe has a holistic approach targeting consistent improvement in merchant and customer experience and quality. Mswipe aims to ensure quick and effective handling of grievances, as well as prompt corrective & preventive action to avoid recurrence.

- This Policy stipulates the guiding principle, standard operating procedure, and framework for (i) customer protection; (ii) limiting customer liability in respect of unauthorized electronic payment transactions and (iii) for registering, processing and closing a customer grievance.

- This policy document aims at minimizing instances of merchant and customer complaints and grievances through proper service delivery & review mechanism and also to ensure prompt redressal of merchant complaints and grievances.

- We aim to provide quick and effective handling of merchants’ and customers’ grievances, as well as prompt corrective & preventive action in order to avoid recurrence.

- 2. Definitions

- The following terms are used in this policy with the meaning specified herein:

- Merchant”

- means a person who may avail both POS & digital payment facilities from Mswipe as per the existing policies of Mswipe

- Customer" means

- a person or consumer making a payment at a merchant's physical location using a POS (Point of Sale) terminal or avails digital payment solution offered by the merchants (via online / offline mode) using various payment options such as credit card, debit card etc.

- Query

- ” - These may be general enquiries, primarily related to Mswipe products, plans & services.

- Request

- ” – Any requests raised for support on Mswipe products, activation/deactivation of value-added services & any other additional services & features.

- “Complaint / Grievance”

- A communication by prospective/existing merchant of Mswipe that express dissatisfaction because of lack of action, inadequate quality of services by Mswipe.

- “Working Days”

- shall mean any day on which our office generally is open in Mumbai excluding 2nd, 4th Saturday, all Sundays & Bank Holidays (Maharashtra)

- 3. Modes of Complaint Registration:

- a.

- Touch points to report grievances by Merchants

- i. Contact us on Toll Free Number 1800 1022 699 (Monday – Saturday: 10.00 AM to 07.00 PM IST) (Merchant needs to enter the registered mobile number on IVR)

- ii. Write an email to helpdesk@mswipe.com via registered email id (Monday – Saturday: 10.00 AM to 07.00 PM IST) (Merchant can use registered email ID. If the same is unavailable, they can provide any one detail - Device ID, TID, Customer code, or Mobile number in mail subject

- iii. WhatsApp Contact- Initiate contact with our Customer Support on WhatsApp by sending a message containing ‘Hi’ to the WhatsApp number +919820522699. If contacted from an unregistered number, the WhatsApp BOT will request a registered number to proceed.

- iv. Mswipe Merchant Application: Use the "Contact Us" feature which includes toll-free / WhatsApp and email support.

- b.

- Touch points to report grievances by Customers:

- Customer can escalate the issues to the Grievance Redressal Officer and Nodal Officer details of which are mentioned below:

- c.

- Details of Grievance Redressal Officer and Nodal Officer:

- Grievance Redressal Officer contact details are as below:

- Mr. Harshad Kadam

- Marathon Futurex, 26th Floor, A Wing, Mafatlal Mills Compound

- N.M. Joshi Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai – 400 013

- Email id: grievance@mswipe.com

- Nodal Officer contact details are as below:

- Ms. Wasifa Shaikh

- Email id: nodalofficer@mswipe.com

- 4. Recording and tracking of grievances:

- i. Any grievance received by Mswipe either verbally or email or in writing, must be recorded and tracked for end-to-end resolution through CRM.

- ii. Acknowledgement is provided for every grievance logged in the form of ticket number

- iii. Mswipe shall not only ensure that all the issues are recorded and resolved but shall also ensure effective monitoring /escalation mechanism to the senior functionary responsible in case of the grievance not being resolved within defined timelines.

- 5. Turnaround time for resolution of complaints

- i. Depending on the nature of grievance, specific timelines have been set for different categories. Grievances shall be resolved in a proper and time-bound manner with detailed communication to the merchant.

- ii. The merchant and customers shall be kept informed in case of any delay by Mswipe.

- Issue Type - Turn-around Time

- Auto reversal for Failed card/UPI transactions for which we have received excess settlements- T + 5 Days

- Chargebacks- T + 120 Days (Max time frame)

- All other issues- T + 7 Days

- The aforesaid TAT* shall be complied by Mswipe to the extent applicable and may get affected due to dependencies on external factors or third parties which are beyond control of Mswipe.

- * The aforesaid TAT applies only to domestic transactions, i.e., where originator and beneficiary are both in India as per applicable guidelines.

- 6. Mode of response

- Mswipe shall ensure that the mode of response is as per the mode of intimation received e.g., cases received through e-mail shall be responded to though e-mail.

- 7. Escalation of grievances

- Mswipe has a four-tier escalation mechanism for customer grievances, as given below:

- i) Level 1: Mswipe merchant app / WhatsApp/IVR (TFN)Helpdesk / Email.(

- applicable only to merchants

- ii) Level 2: Grievance Redressal Officer (GRO) (

- applicable to merchants and customers

- iii) Level 3: Principal Nodal Officer (PNO). (

- iv) Level 4: Ombudsmen for Digital Transactions. (

- Level 1

- - Mswipe will acknowledge all formal complaints (including complaints lodged through electronic means) within three working days and work to resolve it within a reasonable period, not exceeding 15 days. The 15-day period will be reckoned after all the necessary information sought from the merchant and customer is received.

- Level 2

- - If a merchant is not satisfied with the resolution provided through various channels, merchant can escalate the issues to the Grievance Redressal Officer mentioning the Ticket Number or any specific detail for a resolution.

- Grievance Redressal Officer shall endeavor to respond to each complaint within 8 days from the date of receipt of the complaint.

- Level 3

- - If a merchant or customer is not satisfied with the resolution provided by the GRO, they can further escalate the issues to the Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) mentioning the Ticket Number or any specific detail for a resolution within a period of 7 days.

- Level 4

- - If the issue remains unresolved within 30 days , the merchant and customer may approach Reserve Bank of India under the Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 through the following methods:

- i) Complaint can be made online on the portal https://cms.rbi.org.in

- ii) Physical complaint (letter/post)’ under the Scheme to

- Centralised Receipt and Processing Centre,

- 4th Floor, Reserve Bank of India,

- Sector -17, Central Vista,

- Chandigarh - 160017.

- 8. Employee training and awareness:

- All employees at merchant facing channels and other support departments shall be periodically trained in handling merchant grievances. This would include functional training as well as training in soft skills.

- 9. Review & Oversight of monitoring customer grievances

- i) Place in public domain its grievance redressal policy, including the grievance redressal procedure available for the merchant and customers

- ii) Ensure to have a robust and responsive grievance redressal procedure and clearly indicate the grievance resolution authority who shall be approached by the merchant and customers.

- iii) Make grievance redressal mechanism easily accessible to merchants and customers.

- iv) Advise the merchant and customers about how to make a complaint, to whom such a complaint is to be made, when to expect a reply and what to do if the merchant is not satisfied with the outcome. Display name, address and email ids of the Grievance Redressal officer / Principal Nodal Officer. The time limit for resolution of complaints will be clearly displayed / accessible at all public domains.

- v) Inform the complainant of the option to escalate his complaint to the Ombudsmen for Digital Transactions if the complaint is not redressed within the pre-set time.

- vi) Place in public domain information about Ombudsmen for Digital Transactions.

- 10. Review of Policy:

- The policy has been approved by the Board and is reviewed whenever required or at least annually. These reviews shall consider the following:

- i. Internal factors such as changes in organizational structure or products and services offered

- ii. External factors such as changes in legislation or technological innovation

- iii. The results of the audit, if any, conducted during the year by internal / external auditors.

- Dispute Resolution Framework

- 1. Objective:

- The primary objective of the dispute resolution framework is to facilitate prompt and efficient resolution for disputes related to the POS system, digital payments, transactions and services provided by Mswipe.

- 2. Scope:

- This policy applies to all merchants and customers who utilize Mswipe's POS / digital payment system for payment processing in India.

- 3. Dispute Categories:

- The types of disputes covered under the policy are as follows:

- • Transaction disputes (Failed transactions, settlement disputes, amount deducted services not provided by merchants, duplicate payments etc

- • Technical issues with the devices

- 4. Review and Investigation:

- Upon receiving a dispute, the Mswipe’s Helpdesk team will:

- • Acknowledge receipt of the dispute promptly.

- • Conduct a thorough investigation of the dispute, including reviewing transaction records and system logs.

- 5. Resolution:

- Based on the investigation, we will:

- • Provide a resolution within the stipulated timeframe.

- • If the dispute is found in favor of the merchant, take necessary actions to rectify the issue (e.g., refunding the disputed amount, fixing technical issues).

- • If the dispute is found in favor of Mswipe, provide a clear explanation to the merchant and customer.

- We are committed to maintaining the confidentiality and privacy of all customer and merchant information. Any personal or transactional data provided by the end user during the grievance process will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Policy.

## Privacy Policy

- Thank you for showing interest in

- Mswipe Technologies Private Limited

- (“we”, or “us”), www.mswipe.com (“Website”)! We value the trust you place in us by sharing your personal data on our website. We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use and share your personal data on the website and our payment products and applications.

- Types Of Information We Collect

- We collect personal data from you in a variety of ways when you use our application, such as:

- Account.

- We collect, and associate with your account information, your name, your company’s name, birth date, email address, phone number, profile details, work, gender, business details, address and other personally identifiable information. If you create an account by logging in with your credentials from your third-party account with certain social networking sites (such as Twitter, LinkedIn, Google+ or Facebook), we may receive information about you from such social networking sites, in accordance with the terms and use and privacy policy of that social networking site. We work with such social networking site’s application protocol interface (API) in a way that allows you to authorize us to access your account on that social networking site on your behalf. If you consent to our sharing your information with these social networking sites (e.g., post public content on your wall/profile page), we will share information with them in accordance with your privacy choices. Once we share your information with these social networking sites, the terms and policies of these sites, and not our Privacy Policy, will apply to their use of your information.

- Use Related.

- When you use our Website, App and/or products, we store, process and transmit your files (like images, videos, audio, telephone calls, emails, feedback, postings, comments, log file information from browser, software etc., metadata and other data) and information related to them. If you give us access to your contacts, we will store those contacts on our servers for you to use. This will make it easy for you to do things like share your data, send emails, and invite others to use our Website and/ or App.

- Usage.

- We collect information about your business, expertise, transactions and preferences as per the data input by you. Your devices may also transmit information to us including your location, sales, transactions etc.

- Cookies and other Technologies.

- We use technologies like cookies and pixel tags to provide, improve, protect and promote our Website and/ or App. For example, cookies help us with things like remembering your username for your next visit, understanding how you are interacting with our Website and/ or App, and improving it based on that information. We use software tools to collect information about how you interact with our Website and/ or App, such as clicks, touch gestures, drags, hover-overs, response times and errors. You can re-set your phone settings to not accept cookies, but this may limit your ability to use our Website and/ or App. We may ask our other partners to serve ads or services to your devices, which may use cookies or similar technologies placed by us or the third party. We do not control use of such technologies used by advertisers and partners and we expressly disclaim responsibility for information collected through them.

- Analytic Services.

- We may use third party analytics services such as Google Analytics, KISSmetrics and Comscore based on the need, enabling us to collect information about how you use and interact with our Website and/ or App. Such third party analytics services may use cookies to gather information upon your use of our Website and/ or App. We use these analytics services to analyze how people use our Website and/ or App, to improve them, to customize the content/features users see/use based upon their interests and to send emails or messages to users who are not actively using our Website and/ or App. For more information about how these entities use this information, please refer to their privacy policies made available on their respective websites.

- Information Collected from Third Parties.

- We may receive information about you from third parties that offer hyperlinks to our Website and/ or App on their products and/or services. These third parties may supply us with your information. We may add this information to the information we have already collected from you via our Website and/ or App and/or products and/or services in order to improve the products and/or services we provide on our Website and/ or App.

- How We Use Your Information

- General Use.

- In general, the information you submit to us is used either to respond to requests that you make, or to aid us in serving you better. We may use your information in the following ways:

- (a) To send you a welcome e-mail or message and to verify ownership of the e-mail address or mobile number provided when your user account was created;

- (b) To identify you as a user in our system;

- (c) To provide access to our application;

- (d) To facilitate the creation of and secure your user account;

- (e) To provide improved administration of our application;

- (f) To notify you about updates to our application;

- (g) To improve and customize the quality of experience when you interact with our application;

- (h) To send you administrative e-mail or message notifications, such as security or support and maintenance advices;

- (i) To engage with or contact inactive users of our application;

- (j) To direct certain content and advertisements to you so that you are more likely to see content and advertisements that are relevant to you;

- (k) To analyze the data submitted by you;

- (l) To send offers and promotional materials related to our application and/or products and/or services and those of third parties for marketing and other purposes.

- We may also use and share aggregated or de-identified information for any purpose and in any manner. This anonymous data we share may include non-personally identifiable data that we create using your personal data by excluding information that makes the data personally identifiable.

- “How We Share Your Information”

- We may share information as per terms of this Privacy Policy; however, we shall endeavor that such use of information does not create hindrance on your use of our application. We do not share your personal data with third parties other than as follows:

- "Others working for us."

- We use certain trusted third parties to help us provide, improve, protect, and promote our application (such as third-party analytics tools to help us measure traffic and usage trends for our application). These third parties will access your information only to perform tasks on our behalf and in compliance with this Privacy Policy.

- “Generally with your Consent.”

- Any information or content that you voluntarily disclose for posting on our application may become available to the public, as controlled by any applicable privacy settings that you set. To change your privacy settings on our application, you may change your profile setting. Once you have shared the content/data or made it public, that content/data may be re-shared by others.

- “Enforcing Rights.”

- We may also disclose personal data to enforce our policies, respond to claims that a posting or other content violates others’ rights, or protects anyone’s rights, property or safety.

- "Law & Order."

- We may disclose your information to third parties if we determine that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to: (a) comply with the laws; (b) protect any person from death or serious bodily injury; (c) prevent fraud or abuse of our name, brands, trademarks or such other rights belonging to us or our other users; or (d) protect our rights.

- Stewardship of your data is critical to us and a responsibility that we embrace. We believe that our users’ data should receive the same legal protections regardless of whether it’s stored on our servers or on their home computer systems or devices. We will abide by the following principles when receiving, scrutinizing and responding to government requests for our users’ data:

- Be transparent,

- Fight blanket requests,

- Protect all users, and

- Provide trusted services.

- Storage of Information

- "Retention."

- We will retain your personal data after your last transaction / interaction till the purposes for which we process them (we refer to the purposes as listed above in this policy) are met Or where we are legally obliged to do so by the law, or where this is necessary for defending our interests in the context of judicial proceedings, or establish, exercise or defend our legal rights, we will store the personal data for longer periods. The retention of your personal data is governed by our organizational policy which in turn is in compliance with the applicable laws and regulations. If you have any questions about our retention measures, please contact us.

- Security of Personal Data

- We use commercially reasonable safeguards to help keep the information collected through our application secure and ensuring a level of security (such as requesting a unique password) in commensurate with the risks assessed to the personal data. We protect your personal data against unauthorized destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure of or access to personal data transmitted, stored or otherwise processed. However, no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure and so we cannot fully ensure or provide absolute 100% guarantee of the security of any information you transmit to us or that information on our application may not be accessed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by any person. At the same time, we encourage you to use caution when disclosing personal data online. In case, if you still have any questions about security measures, please contact us.

- DISCLOSING PERSONAL DATA

- We may disclose your personal data to our employees, our subsidiaries, our affiliates, other Mswipe Group Companies, our existing or prospective clients, our vendors (travel and mobility agencies, insurance agencies, archiving agencies, government agencies, regulatory bodies, human resource service providers, legal service providers, statutory and compliance auditors, IT Systems Support Service Providers, third party portals, cloud service providers) as necessary to fulfil the purposes mentioned above in this document. But while sharing your personal data to the vendors and clients, we will ensure that reasonable organizational and technical measures are in place at the vendor’s and client’s place to safeguard your personal data. We may also disclose your personal data where we are legally obliged to do so by the law, or where this is necessary for defending our interests in the context of judicial proceedings, or to establish, exercise or defend our legal rights. We may also transfer personal data in connection with or during negotiation of any merger, financing, acquisition or dissolution, collaboration, transaction or proceeding involving sale, transfer, divestiture, or disclosure of all or a portion of our business or assets. In the event of an insolvency, bankruptcy, or receivership, your information may also be transferred as a business asset. If another entity acquires us or our business or assets, that entity will possess all your information collected by us and will assume the rights and obligations regarding your information as described in this Privacy Policy.

- INTERNATIONAL TRANSFER OF PERSONAL DATA

- We may store, process and transfer the personal data between any of the countries in which we operate to fulfil the purposes as mentioned above in this document. Our Privacy policy and the practices are designed to provide consistent level of protection to the personal data across our offices globally. In case of your personal data being shared with our vendors (travel agencies, insurance agencies, third party portals, cloud service providers, human resource and legal service providers) and existing or prospective clients based out in the countries where we operate or any other country, we will ensure that appropriate or suitable or reasonable organizational and technical measures are in place at the vendor’s and client’s place to safeguard your personal data.

- Your data privacy rights

- In accordance to the applicable data protection laws to us, you have the right to:

- Withdraw your consent for the processing of your personal data based on consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before its withdrawal;

- Receive additional information regarding the processing of your personal data;

- Rectify or update your personal data if it is incorrect or inaccurate;

- In certain cases, to have the erasure of your some or all personal data;

- In certain cases, and on grounds relating to your situation, to object to (part of) the processing of your personal data;

- In certain cases, to restrict of or (part of) the processing of your personal data; and

- Data portability (receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and to (have) transmit(ted) your personal data to another organization)

- Nominate any other individual, in such manner as may be prescribed by the relevant data protection authority who shall, in the event of your death or incapacity, exercise the rights in accordance with the provisions of the applicable data protection laws

- To lodge a complaint to the local data protection authority

- In certain cases, not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you.

- Changes to this Privacy Policy

- We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make any changes to this Privacy Policy, the last modified Privacy Policy shall be applicable to you and will actively inform you of this change at our internal website, or by email or by other communication means.

- Communications

- We may periodically send you free newsletters and promotional communications. When you receive newsletters or promotional communications from us, you may “opt-out” of these emails or messages by following the unsubscribe instructions provided in the email or the message you receive or by contacting us at privacy@mswipe.com. Despite your indicated email preferences, we may send you notices of any updates to our Privacy Policy or other administrative emails.

- Complaints

- You have the right to lodge a complaint at any time to the relevant data protection authority in the country where you usually reside, your country of work or country of infringement in the format as prescribed by them.

- But however, we would appreciate the chance to deal with your concerns before you approach the relevant data protection authority, so please contact us in the first instance.

- Contact US

- We welcome your comments or questions regarding this Privacy Policy or have any questions on our handling of your personal data or want to exercise your data rights Please e-mail us at privacy@mswipe.com or call us at 1800 102 2699 or write to us at the following address:

- Mswipe Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

- Data Protection Officer

- 26th Floor, A Wing, Marathon Futurex,

- We may also use and share aggregated or de-identified information for any purpose and in any manner. This anonymous data we share may include non-personally identifiable data that we create using your personal data by excluding information that makes the data personally identifiable.

- “How We Share Your Information”

- We may share information as per terms of this Privacy Policy; however, we shall endeavor that such use of information does not create hindrance on your use of our application. We do not share your personal data with third parties other than as follows:

- "Others working for us."

- We use certain trusted third parties to help us provide, improve, protect, and promote our application (such as third-party analytics tools to help us measure traffic and usage trends for our application). These third parties will access your information only to perform tasks on our behalf and in compliance with this Privacy Policy.

- “Generally with your Consent.”

- Any information or content that you voluntarily disclose for posting on our application may become available to the public, as controlled by any applicable privacy settings that you set. To change your privacy settings on our application, you may change your profile setting. Once you have shared the content/data or made it public, that content/data may be re-shared by others.

- “Enforcing Rights.”

- We may also disclose personal data to enforce our policies, respond to claims that a posting or other content violates others’ rights, or protects anyone’s rights, property or safety.

- "Law & Order."

- We may disclose your information to third parties if we determine that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to: (a) comply with the laws; (b) protect any person from death or serious bodily injury; (c) prevent fraud or abuse of our name, brands, trademarks or such other rights belonging to us or our other users; or (d) protect our rights.

- Stewardship of your data is critical to us and a responsibility that we embrace. We believe that our users’ data should receive the same legal protections regardless of whether it’s stored on our servers or on their home computer systems or devices. We will abide by the following principles when receiving, scrutinizing and responding to government requests for our users’ data:

- Be transparent,

- Fight blanket requests,

- Protect all users, and

- Provide trusted services.

- Storage of Information

- "Retention."

- We will retain your personal data after your last transaction / interaction till the purposes for which we process them (we refer to the purposes as listed above in this policy) are met Or where we are legally obliged to do so by the law, or where this is necessary for defending our interests in the context of judicial proceedings, or establish, exercise or defend our legal rights, we will store the personal data for longer periods. The retention of your personal data is governed by our organizational policy which in turn is in compliance with the applicable laws and regulations. If you have any questions about our retention measures, please contact us.

- Security of Personal Data

- We use commercially reasonable safeguards to help keep the information collected through our application secure and ensuring a level of security (such as requesting a unique password) in commensurate with the risks assessed to the personal data. We protect your personal data against unauthorized destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure of or access to personal data transmitted, stored or otherwise processed. However, no method of transmission over the internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure and so we cannot fully ensure or provide absolute 100% guarantee of the security of any information you transmit to us or that information on our application may not be accessed, disclosed, altered, or destroyed by any person. At the same time, we encourage you to use caution when disclosing personal data online. In case, if you still have any questions about security measures, please contact us.

- DISCLOSING PERSONAL DATA

- We may disclose your personal data to our employees, our subsidiaries, our affiliates, other Mswipe Group Companies, our existing or prospective clients, our vendors (travel and mobility agencies, insurance agencies, archiving agencies, government agencies, regulatory bodies, human resource service providers, legal service providers, statutory and compliance auditors, IT Systems Support Service Providers, third party portals, cloud service providers) as necessary to fulfil the purposes mentioned above in this document. But while sharing your personal data to the vendors and clients, we will ensure that reasonable organizational and technical measures are in place at the vendor’s and client’s place to safeguard your personal data. We may also disclose your personal data where we are legally obliged to do so by the law, or where this is necessary for defending our interests in the context of judicial proceedings, or to establish, exercise or defend our legal rights. We may also transfer personal data in connection with or during negotiation of any merger, financing, acquisition or dissolution, collaboration, transaction or proceeding involving sale, transfer, divestiture, or disclosure of all or a portion of our business or assets. In the event of an insolvency, bankruptcy, or receivership, your information may also be transferred as a business asset. If another entity acquires us or our business or assets, that entity will possess all your information collected by us and will assume the rights and obligations regarding your information as described in this Privacy Policy.

- INTERNATIONAL TRANSFER OF PERSONAL DATA

- We may store, process and transfer the personal data between any of the countries in which we operate to fulfil the purposes as mentioned above in this document. Our Privacy policy and the practices are designed to provide consistent level of protection to the personal data across our offices globally. In case of your personal data being shared with our vendors (travel agencies, insurance agencies, third party portals, cloud service providers, human resource and legal service providers) and existing or prospective clients based out in the countries where we operate or any other country, we will ensure that appropriate or suitable or reasonable organizational and technical measures are in place at the vendor’s and client’s place to safeguard your personal data.

- Your data privacy rights

- In accordance to the applicable data protection laws to us, you have the right to:

- Withdraw your consent for the processing of your personal data based on consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before its withdrawal;

- Receive additional information regarding the processing of your personal data;

- Rectify or update your personal data if it is incorrect or inaccurate;

- In certain cases, to have the erasure of your some or all personal data;

- In certain cases, and on grounds relating to your situation, to object to (part of) the processing of your personal data;

- In certain cases, to restrict of or (part of) the processing of your personal data; and

- Data portability (receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and to (have) transmit(ted) your personal data to another organization)

- Nominate any other individual, in such manner as may be prescribed by the relevant data protection authority who shall, in the event of your death or incapacity, exercise the rights in accordance with the provisions of the applicable data protection laws

- To lodge a complaint to the local data protection authority

- In certain cases, not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing, including profiling, which produces legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affects you.

- Changes to this Privacy Policy

- We may change this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make any changes to this Privacy Policy, the last modified Privacy Policy shall be applicable to you and will actively inform you of this change at our internal website, or by email or by other communication means.

- Communications

- We may periodically send you free newsletters and promotional communications. When you receive newsletters or promotional communications from us, you may “opt-out” of these emails or messages by following the unsubscribe instructions provided in the email or the message you receive or by contacting us at privacy@mswipe.com. Despite your indicated email preferences, we may send you notices of any updates to our Privacy Policy or other administrative emails.

- Complaints

- You have the right to lodge a complaint at any time to the relevant data protection authority in the country where you usually reside, your country of work or country of infringement in the format as prescribed by them.

- But however, we would appreciate the chance to deal with your concerns before you approach the relevant data protection authority, so please contact us in the first instance.

- Contact US

- We welcome your comments or questions regarding this Privacy Policy or have any questions on our handling of your personal data or want to exercise your data rights Please e-mail us at privacy@mswipe.com or call us at 1800 102 2699 or write to us at the following address:

No interest shall accrue in respect of any such amount that is so withheld.

- 7.1.13.Net payments after deducting the fees, TDR or any other amount payable by the Merchant to Mswipe shall be made to the Merchant by Mswipe directly into the respective account of the Merchant or by cheques.

- 7.1.14.Rejection of Payment: Mswipe and the Facility Providers may reject payment in respect of any Transaction including but not limited for the following reasons:

- 7.1.14.1.The Merchant has not obtained a necessary authorisation or Mswipe, the Facility Providers and the Acquiring Banks are entitled to reject payment in terms of these Terms and Conditions;

- 7.1.14.2.Any Transaction which the Customer refuses to pay because the product / services provided by the Merchant to the Customer was not as promised or was defective or was not delivered;

- 7.1.14.3.Mswipe determines that the CTRLPay Wallet details does not match any number on file;

- 7.1.14.5.Any charge/ debit, which is a suspect charge/debit or is thought to be irregular or fraudulent in nature by Mswipe, facility Provider, in its sole opinion and assessment;

- 7.1.15.Mswipe shall be entitled to set off and deduct from any payment due to the Merchant, and in doing so Mswipe may:-

- 7.1.15.1.debit the Merchant’s account held with Mswipe, forthwith; and/or;

- 7.1.15.2.deduct the outstanding amount from subsequent credits to the Merchant’s account; and/or

- 7.1.15.3.if there are insufficient funds available in the Merchant’s account, Mswipe shall claim from the Merchant the amount from the Merchant and the Merchant shall forthwith on receipt of the claim from Mswipe pay the outstanding of the refund to the extent to which such funds prove inadequate.

- 7.1.16.Merchant’s Security Deposit Account Balance: Mswipe may, at its sole discretion and with prior intimation to the Merchant, retain a minimal amount out of amounts payable to the Merchant (“Reserve Amount”). The Merchant agrees that Mswipe may impose Transaction limits or additional Reserve Amount, either temporarily or permanently, which are more restrictive than limits placed on the Merchants in order to reduce Mswipe’s risk of loss under varying circumstances.

- 8.REFUNDS AND RECOURSE

- 8.1.The Merchant shall inform the Customer and prominently display on the Merchant’s location or platform the return and credit refund policy.

- 8.2.If in respect of any transaction, any Goods/ Services are not received as described, by the Customer or are lawfully rejected or accepted for or services are not performed or partly performed or cancelled or price is lawfully disputed by the Customer or price adjustment is allowed or the Merchant expresses inability to deliver the Goods and/or perform the Services fully or partially after capturing the transaction and before the Delivery but post settlement or if the Merchant accepts the Customer claims for crediting his account back after the Delivery of Goods and Services and settlement, the Merchant shall not make a cash refund but shall provide the invoice and other relevant documents to Mswipe for verification and investigation. The Merchant shall sign and date each invoice and other related documents to be provided to Mswipe and include a brief description of the items concerned therein.

- 8.3.The Merchant must raise a refund request through Mswipe Products in the manner and process prescribed by Mswipe. The Merchant must not process a refund transaction, unless there is a preceding corresponding debit to the Customer’s account. In the event that only Transaction Receipt are presented to Mswipe at any time, the Merchant shall at the same time make payment of the net refund (i.e. the total refund(s) to the Customer(s) less the discount) to Mswipe. The Merchant shall ensure that Mswipe has enough funds of the Merchants to process any refund request received from the Merchant. Mswipe shall not be liable to process any refunds request in case of insufficiency of Merchant’s funds.

- 8.4.The Merchant agrees and acknowledges that refunds shall not be processed by Mswipe after a period of 180 (One Hundred and Eighty) days from the date of transaction.

- 8.5.The Merchant further agrees and acknowledges that, in case of any refund or Chargeback, the TDR charged by Mswipe shall not be refunded to the Merchant or the Customer.

- 9.CHARGEBACKS

- 9.1.The Merchant undertakes that any charges accepted by Mswipe, which prove to be uncollectable and or are Chargebacks, shall be the exclusive financial responsibility of the Merchant. The Merchant undertakes to pay such uncollectible charges and or Chargeback (including any processing fees or any other fees incurred by Mswipe in respect of such Chargeback) without any demur or protest. The Merchant shall furnish all documents including Delivery proof etc. within 5 (five) days of request received from Mswipe.

- 9.2.The Merchant shall repay amounts with respect of a transaction including but not limited to on the occurrence of any of the events:

- 9.2.1.Any charge/debit on a Valid Mode arising out of any hacking, breach of security or encryption (if any) that may be attributable to the Merchant due to the manner in which the Merchant handled the Customer information or Cardholder/ transaction details.

- 9.2.2.The Transaction is for any reason unlawful or unenforceable.

- 9.2.3.Any information presented electronically to Mswipe in respect of the Transaction is not received in accordance with Mswipe’s requirements from time to time.

- 9.2.4.Transaction is posted more than once to Customer’s account.

- 9.2.5.The Transaction is doubtful or erroneously paid to the Merchant.

- 9.2.6.The Product or Services are rejected or returned, or the Customer disputes the nature, quality, quantity of the Goods or Services.

- 9.2.7.The transaction is validly cancelled or terminated by the Customer.

- 9.2.8.The Customer disputes or denies the occurrence of the transaction or the sale or Delivery of the Goods or Services covered by the transaction.

- 9.2.9.Any other events or circumstances under which a Chargeback is mandated to be effected under the card association rules or Applicable Laws.

- 9.2.10.Any other event or circumstance which Mswipe shall from time to time notify to the Merchant in writing shall have occurred at the date of the transaction.

- 10. WITHHOLDING

- 10.1.Subject to Applicable Laws, all Transaction Amount due to the Merchant under these Terms and Conditions may be withheld or delayed till such time as Mswipe and/or Facility Providers deems fit, if (a) the Merchant or its Customer or a third party commits any fraud or violates any law or legal requirement; (b) Mswipe and/or the Facility Provider have reasons to believe that a fraud has been committed against the Customers, Mswipe and/or Facility Provider, its Customers, or any other third party; or has reason to believe that the Merchant or the Customer has in connivance with any other person done any fraud or assisted in the same; or any transaction has been fraudulently initiated; (c) the Merchant has excessive pending Chargebacks or poses high Chargeback and/or refund risk; (d) continuous non-Delivery or delayed Delivery of Merchant’s Goods and/or Services to customers; or (e) for any other reasonable reasons in accordance with Applicable Laws. In the event of suspended or delayed payments mentioned above, Mswipe shall intimate the same to the Merchant as per the Applicable Laws.

- 10.2.It is agreed between the Parties that in the event any amount to be received from the Merchant by Mswipe is over and above the amount which has been withheld by Mswipe, Mswipe shall have a right to raise an invoice relating to such payments to be made and the Merchant agrees to make payments of such invoice within a period of 5 (five) days of receiving the invoice. Such unpaid amounts by the Merchant shall be subject to an interest, chargeable at the rate of two percent (2 %) per month after the expiry of 5 (five) days.

- 10.3.This Clause shall survive any termination of these Terms and Conditions.

title: Merchant App & Portal for Business Tracking | Mswipe
markdown:
## Benefits from merchant app

## Seamless payment acceptance

- The Mswipe Merchant App streamlines payments, whether through cards, UPI or pay by link which gives access to pay via net banking. Its intuitive design ensures even first-time users can navigate effortlessly.

## Real-time transaction tracking

- Stay on top of your business with instant access to payment history, sales performance, and transaction details.

## Settlement Overview

- View daily and monthly settlement reports to manage cash flow and keep your business running smoothly.

## Built-In Support Access

- Reach your relationship manager or raise support tickets directly through the app for quick issue resolution.

## User & Access Management

- Add new team members, assign admin roles, and control device-level access — all from the app.

## Benefits from merchant portal

## Powerful business dashboard

- Monitor payment trends, top-performing days, and settlement summaries with data-driven visuals.

- Accept dynamic QR payments, Pay by Link, and more — all from one portal with an intuitive, easy-to-use interface.

- Raise support tickets directly through the portal for quick issue resolution.

- Add new team members, assign admin roles, and control device-level access — all from the portal.
